name: The 90-Second Mystery
description:
Griffith University is running a cybersecurity outreach simulation based on a fictional concert-ticket incident.

During the simulated Starlight Arena presale, every ticket sold out in only 90 seconds. The Griffith cybersecurity investigation team suspects that an automated ticket-buying bot overwhelmed the ticket server.

Investigators recovered a network traffic summary from the sale window. Most customers generated only a small number of requests, but one source behaved very differently.

## Your Mission

Analyse `traffic_log.csv` and identify the suspicious source IP responsible for the automated activity.

Submit your answer using the `GRIFFITH{...}` flag format, replacing dots in the IP address with underscores.

Example:

`192.0.2.10` → `GRIFFITH{192_0_2_10}`

hints.title: Hint 1: Spot the Outlier
hints.content: Most fans only refresh a ticket page a few times. Look for a source whose request count is wildly different from everyone else.

hints.title: Hint 2: Rank the Traffic
hints.content: Compare the requests column first. Sorting by request count will make the automated source stand out immediately.
